watches.name: Fir Tree
watches.description: Three Peaks Fir Tree A Swiss automatic column-wheel chronograph. A limited edition available exclusively at the launch of the Three Peaks collection, with individually numbered pieces. Fir Tree is inspired by Alpine forests and the calm of untouched nature. Its green dial evokes the wilderness, the green nubuck strap its natural textures, and the warm gold-plated case the light filtering through the trees at dawn and dusk. Movement Calibre: La Joux-Perret L112, automatic, column-wheel chronograph Power reserve: 60 hours, 26 jewels Functions: hours, minutes, seconds, stop-seconds, chronograph (hours, minutes, seconds) Finishing: Côtes de Genève, perlage, blued screws, palladium treatment, custom Favre-Bulle rotor with gold engravings A column wheel is the most refined way to control a chronograph. It is harder to produce and adjust, and gives a smoother, more precise push-piece action. Case Gold-plated 316L stainless steel, 41 mm diameter, 13.5 mm thick 50 mm lug to lug, 20 mm lug width Polished bezel, satin-brushed sides and caseback, perlage and engraving Sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating Water resistance: 5 ATM (50 m) Dial Forest green, grained finish Satin-brushed and polished sub-dials Bevelled hour and minute hands; sub-dial hands shaped like mountain peaks Circular-brushed flange Strap Forest green nubuck leather, handmade by a family-run Belgian workshop 20/18 mm, quick-release spring bars Brushed single deployant buckle with engraved logo Delivered with Signature travel box, certificate of authenticity and a handwritten welcome note. 2-year international warranty. Designed in Geneva. Swiss Made.
